assets.name: ally
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, single transparent battle ground sigil. Supporting style reference is the approved screenshot: use ONLY the silver-blue circular runic engravings under the LEFT allied combatants as inspiration, not the screenshot itself.
Create one perfectly overhead, unforeshortened circular weathered silver-cyan rune engraving as a transparent PNG, centered on a square canvas. The renderer will flatten it into an ellipse. Thin two concentric engraved arcs, broken in a few small places, with 24–32 handcrafted occult glyph marks between them. Subtle moon-silver metal, aged chiselled edges, faint cyan illumination, a few tiny dust specks closely along outer edge. Premium gothic RPG painterly surface detail. Total sigil diameter about 84% of canvas; broad completely TRANSPARENT center occupying 66% of diameter, thin rune band, fully TRANSPARENT outside. No opaque black or colored disk, no stone ground or square image background, no contact shadow filling the center, no checkerboard pixels. Calm silver engraving with restrained blue glints; maintain clear readable silhouette when rendered 150 pixels wide. NO characters, names, letters, readable words, UI, square, diamond, platform slab, pedestal, border, central symbol, panel, spikes or floating object. True alpha cutout. No perspective at generation.
